records.name: React UButton
records.purpose: Native action button with loading/disabled gating, icons, badge and optional tooltip. Reuses the pilot react.button identity rather than introducing a second product.
records.surface: UButton and UButtonProps expose a forwarded HTMLButtonElement ref. UButtonProps extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "disabled">: native events, children and attributes remain available. Adds label:string, icon/loadingIcon:ReactNode, iconPos:left|right|top|bottom, loading/disabled, severity:secondary|success|info|warning|danger|help|contrast, size:small|large, text/raised/rounded/outlined/link/plain, badge/badgeClassName (the badge renders through UBadge, ADR-088), visible, tooltip and tooltipOptions:Record<string,unknown>. visible=false returns null; loading disables the button. Label plus badge supplies aria-label when label exists, even over an explicit aria-label; type defaults to button but rest attributes follow it. Internal setRef/renderIcon and buttonStyleModule belong here. ButtonClassesParams is an owned source-only class resolver contract for hasIcon/label/loading/severity/raised/rounded/text/outlined/link/plain/size/iconPos; not a barrel export. USpinnerIcon and UTooltip are dependencies, not owned products. Public runtime and props type are named exports from both @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/button. The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core owns cx class resolution and delegates mounting/style registration to useComponentStyle; those hooks are external foundation records, not duplicated here. Local style CSS is registered; no scoped style module imports @ultimate/uix-styles. Comments claiming missing shared modules are historical, not availability evidence. Aura registry key button exists; this local structural CSS has no dt() token references. BUTTON_METADATA names this React sourcePath.

records.name: React UBadge
records.purpose: Standalone status badge showing a value, with severity and size, a dot for an empty value and a circle for one character.
records.surface: UBadge and UBadgeProps forward an HTMLSpanElement ref; the ref is the root span, where PrimeReact exposes getElement() (ADR-088). UBadgeProps extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "children">: value:string|number|null, severity:secondary|info|success|warn|warning|danger|contrast (warning is an alias of warn), size:small|large|xlarge, unstyled:boolean, pt and ptOptions; className, style and the other span attributes are merged onto the root with ptm('root'). The root renders value. BadgeSeverity is exported from the barrel; BadgeClassesParams and badgeStyleModule are owned source-only declarations. The shared @ultimate/uix-styles/badge module supplies the structural CSS (ADR-082), and badgeStyleModule adds the .u-overlaybadge wrapper rules that replace PrimeReact's .p-overlay-badge; there is no React OverlayBadge component, as in PrimeReact. Public runtime and types are named exports from both @ultimate/react and @ultimate/react/badge. The manifest advertises dist entry/type paths; this does not prove a built or published package. useComponentBase from @ultimate/react-core owns cx class resolution; createPassThrough owns ptm. Aura registry key badge matches componentName and the dt() references in the shared module. No dedicated record for this family is present in the current metadata registry; no metadata association is inferred from its name.
